messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

The head has large round dark eyes with blue rims, a wide slightly smiling mouth, and dark speckling on top, with multiple pink stalked feathery external gills with red filaments projecting from the sides just behind the head. The body is low to the ground on four short thick limbs with clawed toes, and the tail extends to the left, pink and ringed underneath and scaled on top.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad rounded pale pink with dark speckles, large eyes and wide mouth", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body on the right side of the image"}, {"looks_like": "large round black pupils with light blue rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "wide horizontal slightly upturned slit", "part": "mouth", "where": "across the lower front of the head"}, {"looks_like": "pink fleshy stalks with fine red feathery filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "projecting from the sides of the head just behind the head, four visible on the near side and three on the far side"}, {"looks_like": "pale pink deeply wrinkled and segmented soft skin", "part": "body", "where": "forming the underside and sides of the torso between the head and tail and between the legs"}, {"looks_like": "short thick pale pink wrinkled limbs", "part": "legs", "where": "two on the near side and two on the far side under the torso, supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "broad pink toes tipped with small dark claws, five on each front foot and five on each hind foot", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering, pink ringed underneath and continuing the back scales on top, narrowing to a point on the left", "part": "tail", "where": "extending to the left from the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping rounded brown to gray-brown hard plates with a glossy highlight", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the entire arched back from behind the head to the tip of the tail"}, {"looks_like": "small dark gray-brown speckles", "part": "markings", "where": "scattered on the top and sides of the head"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
